title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 17.7 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab Enterprise Edition versions from 17.7 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 allowed an authenticated user to read Duo seat assignments and usage data from other groups due to improper authorization checks. This issue has been remediated by GitLab.
